t: The homeland of the Adyghe peoples between the Black Sea, the Kuban river and the north-western Caucasus.
It had no king or capital: princely societies and self-governing free communities shared a language and the code Adyghe Khabze.
A century of war with Russia ended in 1864 with conquest and the deportation of most Circassians to the Ottoman Empire.
dyk: From the accession of Barquq in 1382 until 1517, most sultans of Mamluk Egypt and Syria were Circassians who had been brought to Cairo as slave soldiers.
ev: Ivan the Terrible marries Maria Temryukovna, daughter of the Kabardian prince Temryuk
Kabardians defeat a Crimean army at the Battle of Kanzhal
Russia founds Mozdok, beginning its advance into Kabarda
Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca recognises Kabarda as Russian
Ottomans cede the Circassian coast to Russia in the Treaty of Adrianople
Circassian delegates meet in a united assembly at Sochi
Russia ends Circassian resistance; mass deportation to the Ottoman Empire

f.capital: None; princely seats and tribal assemblies
